The third trimester of pregnancy is the highest risk period of gestation. If the pregnant client has anemia (any type) 
during pregnancy, they will have a decreased tolerance of blood loss occurring during birth, increasing their risk for 
hypovolemic shock, heart failure, infection, and the need for blood transfusion (Sharma et al., 2021; Smith et al., 
2019). See Table 10.1 for complications and risks associated with anemia in pregnancy.
